_readme: Settings for host-monitor. Push a change to the board with:
Every key is optional -- delete this file and the app runs on its compiled
defaults. Two things are deliberately NOT here:
- Wi-Fi credentials and the setup-portal password. Both are WPA2
credentials, so they belong in lib/board/secrets.h. This file sits on a
filesystem anyone holding the board can dump. See SECURITY.md.
- The transport (USB serial vs HTTP). That stays a compile-time choice,
because the two paths pull in different libraries and a runtime switch
would mean building both into every image.
The default build reads stats over USB serial, which needs no network and
no Wi-Fi setup on the host -- so agent.url below only matters if you
_agent: Where to fetch stats from in the HTTP build. A .local name is resolved by mDNS.
_refresh: pollSeconds   how often to ask the agent, 1-3600. It is cheap; 5s feels live.
retrySeconds  back-off while the agent is unreachable, 1-3600.
staleSeconds  how long a silent feed stays trusted, 2-3600. Forced to at
least two polls, because a window shorter than the poll
interval marks a healthy feed stale between updates and looks
_timing: Seconds each page of stats stays up, 2-600.
_brightness: OPTIONAL backlight override, 8-255. Omit either key and that level comes
from the active colour scheme instead. Backlight is the one dial that
measurably moves power: duty 140 measures 45.1C at the die, 60 is 40.5C.
_night: Hours (0-23) the night brightness applies. Wraps midnight.
